description: Find where something is discussed inside a file attached to a note. Returns short passages with the page each is on. Use it when a file's text was too long to be included whole, or to locate a topic before reading around it. Requires note_id.

file.description: The attachment's filename, exactly as it is written in the block holding that file's text.

note_id.description: Which note the file is attached to, as returned by search_notes or list_notes. Ignored in the app's own assistant, where the note is the one already open.

query.description: Words to look for inside the file. Keywords work better than a sentence, and the exact phrase ranks above the same words scattered apart.

name: scratchpad_search_attachment
title: Search attachment
